payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the pruning process used in the KDG model, including its purpose and impact on model performance.

claims.text: The pruning algorithm eliminates spurious logical forms from the training data, which significantly improves the accuracy of the KDG model.

The pruning process involves generating fictitious tables and filtering out logical forms that do not yield correct answers on these tables, resulting in a reduction of 92.1% of spurious logical forms.
